_doc: Revert-verify mutants for issue #4551 / req 60ed88e7 (vault-exodev task c223e6ef, RFC 14217015 P1.5): a SPARQL BIND extends the group prefix at its position. Each mutant removes one guarantee and must redden exactly the axes in `expect` (pairwise distinct within the spec). `red_re` anchors on the jest failure header `● <suite> › Bn @req` (ITRV §A44/§A104). `tree`/`subject` are placeholders — run the matrix on a copy with the paths substituted (§A145). Subject: AlgebraOptimizer.reorderJoin never moves a pattern ahead of a preceding BIND. ⛔ Round 5 (conservative strategy, orchestrator's decision by mandate): AlgebraOptimizer is the base c64bcd41 file plus two Extend gates (no FILTER pushdown and no join reordering in a join with a BIND) and containsExtend. Mutants AO3–AO15 targeted guards of the round-1..4 pushdown refinements; that code is gone, so are they. B43/B44 (BIND-free plans keep their answer) have no single-anchor mutant (ITRV §A138): the guarantee is the ABSENCE of a change to the base pushdown — its flip is two revisions (AlgebraOptimizer.ts from 3378ddb2: B43 and B44 red; this revision: green).

AO1_guard_off._note: The reordering may swap a constrained later pattern to the left of a BIND (the join-order gate is off).

AO2_guard_shallow._note: containsExtend sees an Extend only as a DIRECT child, not deeper (e.g. under a LeftJoin) — both gates miss it. Re-anchored in round 5: the old mutation (no recursion at all) now switched both gates off for every join, the AO1 + AO16 union.

AO16_pushdown_gate_off._note: A group FILTER over a join with a BIND goes through the base pushdown again: the base reports no variables for an Extend, so a filter on a shared variable is pushed into the right operand and the bind join substitutes an IRI into its expression — every row dropped (the round-1 CRITICAL and its successors). Type-preserving: an impossible conjunct. B28–B30 (a BIND of ?window read in arithmetic / IN / a cast): the base does not walk those nodes and pushes the filter where ?window is substituted or unbound; B32: its plain reference (a mid-group BIND + a filter on ?s) is broken the same way.
